# Open Source Design

> A community platform connecting open source projects with designers and fostering collaboration between FOSS development and user experience.

Open Source Design serves as a hub for the intersection of open source software and design practice, hosting a job board, event information, educational resources, and community guidelines. The community organizes events like the FOSDEM Open Source Design devroom and collaborates with organizations including Mozilla, Simply Secure, and Canonical to advance design quality in free and open source software.

## Core & Mission

- [Open Source Design](https://opensourcedesign.net): Homepage connecting open source projects with design community
- [Goals](https://opensourcedesign.net/goals): Mission statement and organizational goals for Open Source Design
- [Manifesto](https://opensourcedesign.net/manifesto): Design principles and community values for open source design

## Jobs & Opportunities

- [Jobs](https://opensourcedesign.net/jobs): Job board for design and UX roles in open source projects
- [How to Make a Successful Job Post](https://opensourcedesign.net/2024/05/09/oss-projects-here-is-how-to-make-a-successful-job-post.html): Guide on creating effective job postings for open source projects

## Events & Community

- [Events](https://opensourcedesign.net/events): Community events and FOSDEM devroom information
- [Call for Participation: FOSDEM 2026](https://opensourcedesign.net/2025/10/01/fosdem-cfp-2026): Call for speakers at FOSDEM 2026 Open Source Design devroom

## Resources & Learning

- [Resources](https://opensourcedesign.net/resources): Design tools, icon libraries, fonts and open-licensed assets
- [Articles](https://opensourcedesign.net/articles): Archive of articles and conference recaps from community events

## Getting Involved

- [Contribute](https://opensourcedesign.net/contribute): Guide for contributing to Open Source Design community
